response.content: The video begins with the title "The Mobile Movement" and a Google logo on a smartphone. It displays various statistics about mobile usage, noting that 63% access social networks, 33% watch TV, and 22% read newspapers. It highlights that 79% use phones for shopping, with 70% doing so in-store and 74% making purchases based on search. Further stats show 76% purchasing in-store, 59% on PCs, and 35% on smartphones. 88% take action within the same day, with 61% calling businesses and 59% visiting them. 71% search for items like hotels or cars. 17% search after seeing a mobile display ad, and 43% after a TV ad. 9 out of 10 credit smartphone search. 79% lack mobile-optimized sites, yet 42% click ads, 35% visit sites, 49% make purchases, and 27% call businesses. The video concludes with the URL www.google.com/mobileads.
